nodes.title: Early Game Foundation
nodes.transition_goal: Transition smoothly into the early-midgame by continuing to expand and tech up, while starting to build a defensive army.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overproducing units that might not be useful against the opponent's eventual composition. Keep options open.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to maintain the current path, focusing on expanding the economy and technology while producing Stalkers for defense. Keep production moderate to allow for flexibility.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent's army composition becomes apparent or when reaching the midgame.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move into a midgame with heavy production, a ground-based army, and the addition of Immortals and Oracles.

nodes.strategic_reason: The heavy economy and technology investment will pay off in the midgame, and Stalkers provide a versatile defensive unit that can also be used for harassment.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a full midgame posture with heavier production and a more defined army composition.
nodes.trigger_summary: As the game progresses into the early-midgame, maintain the economic and technological lead while starting to build a ground-based army.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being caught off guard by a sudden tech switch or mass air from the opponent. Keep scouting and be ready to adjust.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain the current army path and production, but be ready to adapt based on scouting. Continue to expand and tech up while keeping a strong defense.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when the opponent's strategy is fully scouted or when a decisive engagement is imminent.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue to develop the army and economy, preparing for the next phase of the game.
nodes.opponent_situation: The opponent's composition is still not fully known, but the possibility of pressure or aggression is present.
nodes.own_situation: Heavy economy, production, technology, and expansion. The army is ground-based with Stalkers, Immortals, and Oracles, and there is a moderate air presence. Defensive posture is heavy, and pressure is possible.
nodes.strategic_reason: The combination of Stalkers, Immortals, and Oracles provides a strong ground-based army with support capabilities. Heavy production and economy allow for sustained pressure or defense.
nodes.title: Midgame Consolidation
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a late-game composition or a timing attack based on the opponent's weaknesses.
nodes.trigger_summary: In the midgame, consolidate the army composition and production to match the opponent's strategy.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order. Adapt based on scouting and live game state.

Early game focuses on establishing a solid economic base and teching up, with a gradual transition to a ground-based army composition featuring Stalkers and later Immortals and Oracles.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a balanced macro posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
